coverage.summary: Applies to rental dwelling units offered for rent by housing providers for residential purposes, except units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
coverage.owner_conditions: Units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are excluded from 'rental dwelling unit'.

evidence.quoted_span: owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

result.notes: The coverage values match the 'Rental dwelling unit' definition in C.46:8-54 and are left unchanged. The act contains no unit-count threshold, construction-date cutoff, new-construction exemption, landlord-size condition, or preemption or local-yield clause, so those fields stay null. D066 to D069 and DX16 concern other statutes and do not affect this rule's coverage.
